title: CPLN 5920 Portfolio
text:
This portfolio documents my learning journey in Public Policy Analytics (CPLN 5920/MUSA 5080).


Advanced spatial analysis and data science for urban planning and public policy.




Weekly Notes: My learning reflections and key concepts
Labs: Completed assignments and analyses
Final Project: Capstone modeling challenge




Wesley Nay
I am a first year Master of City Planning student concentrating in Housing, Community, and Economic Development. I earned my Bachelor of Science from Elmhurst University with double majors in Sociology and Urban Studies. I briefly worked in policy research between university and beginning the MCP at Penn.
Previous experience:

New York City Independent Budget Office
University of Chicago Urban Labs - Inclusive Economy Lab

Why this course?
I am taking this course because I am interested in a career in policy analysis. I have some limited experience in public sector analysis but was limited by my lack of quantitative technical skills. I hope to become proficient in R to be qualified to be an analyst.




Email: wesnay@design.upenn.edu
GitHub: @wesleynay
